raw_http_text: {"id":"b87a2b78-7aee-4cde-855f-5cf5ff78235f_2srk78g3z7tp8dpwxs_c7070fdd4f864b44a7a2a68934baf2f2","choices":[{"finish_reason":"stop","index":0,"message":{"content":"{\"schema_version\":\"1.0\",\"packet_id\":\"CAND_TOPIC_01_R2_V1\",\"mode\":\"organized_reflection\",\"sentences\":[{\"text\":\"大气二氧化碳增加会使溶入海洋的二氧化碳随之增加，但该证据未给出某一年吸收的比例、速度或上限。\",\"citations\":[\"CL_E04\"],\"kind\":\"limitation\"},{\"text\":\"海洋酸化指氢离子浓度上升、pH下降的方向，海水平均仍呈碱性不妨碍酸化继续发生。\",\"citations\":[\"CL_E05\"],\"kind\":\"paraphrase\"},{\"text\":\"2016年植被变绿研究区分观测与归因，叶面积增加的检出依赖数据，各驱动因素作用需借助模型判断。\",\"citations\":[\"CL_E06\"],\"kind\":\"limitation\"},{\"text\":\"在该研究仅提供观测与模型归因区分、未给出各因素独立贡献数值的条件下，能否据此推断某单一驱动因素的贡献大小？\",\"citations\":[\"CL_E06\"],\"kind\":\"question\"}]}","role":"assistant","tool_calls":null}}],"created":1794399766,"model":"mimo-v2.6-flash","object":"chat.completion","usage":{"completion_tokens":217,"prompt_tokens":1888,"total_tokens":2105,"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":0},"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":1664}}}
